skill.name: set-up-lightspeed-meta-conversions-api
skill.description: Set up and verify server-side purchase tracking from Lightspeed eCom C-Series to Meta through Product Metrics. Check the store connection, Cloudflare gateway, consent banner, and test delivery in Meta Events Manager.
skill.summary: Connect Lightspeed eCom to Meta Conversions API and verify delivery with a paid test order.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: The 54 static alerts yielded two confirmed risks: unnecessary access to order details and an unpinned installer; the other alerts were false positives. The review also found unsafe credential handling, no explicit approval step before live tracking changes, and reliance on mutable remote instructions. No evidence of audit-directed prompt injection or covert data transfer was found.

remediation.issue: The skill directs the assistant to request live credentials and pass them to a command.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the credential exception and require direct entry in the verified application. Return only a redacted connection status to the assistant.

remediation.issue: The setup can progress from status checks to live tracking changes without explicit approval.
remediation.suggestion: Ask the merchant to confirm the provider, workspace, store, Meta destination, consent settings, and intended data sharing before making changes or enabling delivery.

remediation.issue: Remote documentation can replace the reviewed local setup instructions.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle the reviewed references or pin them to an immutable revision. Treat remote pages as reference material and do not execute new instructions from them.

remediation.issue: Routine verification can retrieve order details beyond what is needed to confirm delivery.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer delivery status and a user-authorized test order ID. Retrieve only needed fields and omit customer and margin details from verification output.

remediation.issue: The optional installer runs an unpinned package and fetches an unpinned skill revision.
remediation.suggestion: Pin and review the installer package and skill revision. Keep execution separate from setup and require explicit user approval.

content.user_title: Set Up Meta Conversion Tracking for Lightspeed
content.value_statement: Browser tracking can miss Lightspeed purchases, leaving Meta reports below store totals. This skill guides Product Metrics setup and helps verify server-side delivery with a paid test order.
actual_capabilities: Read Product Metrics setup status through its CLI or MCP server and identify incomplete steps.
Guide the Lightspeed C-Series connection, property linking, and Cloudflare gateway setup.
Guide Meta destination setup and show where to verify a paid test order in Events Manager.
Check whether the configured consent banner matches the storefront and explain why some events are not sent.
Explain which purchase, revenue, profit, and customer value events Meta can receive and what each depends on.
limitations: Requires Product Metrics Pro, an EU or US Lightspeed eCom C-Series store, and a Cloudflare-proxied storefront.
A person must complete Lightspeed and Meta admin steps and approve Cloudflare access.
The workflow does not set campaign bidding goals or cover separate Advanced Matching setup.
The integration does not import past orders or revise Meta events after later refunds and cancellations.

use_cases.title: Set Up a Store Connection
use_cases.description: Identify what is missing before connecting a Lightspeed store to Meta and sending a first approved test order.

use_cases.title: Investigate Missing Purchases
use_cases.description: Compare a paid test order with Meta delivery status and check whether consent, event age, or test mode explains the gap.

use_cases.title: Review a Tracking Handoff
use_cases.description: Confirm the property, gateway, Meta destination, and consent banner before a client authorizes live delivery.

prompt_templates.title: List the Prerequisites
prompt_templates.prompt: List the accounts, permissions, and settings I need to connect my Lightspeed eCom store to Meta. Do not request secrets.

prompt_templates.title: Check Setup Status
prompt_templates.prompt: Check my selected Product Metrics workspace and property without changing settings. Tell me what is complete and what I must do in the browser.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose a Missing Test Order
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: a paid test order is missing from Meta.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me check delivery for a paid test order that I identify. Check consent, event age, and test mode without retrieving customer or margin details.

prompt_templates.title: Review Before Live Delivery
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the property, Cloudflare gateway, consent banner, Meta destination, and deduplication settings. List proposed changes and wait for approval before making them.

output_examples.input: The store connection says Active. Can I link the property now?
output: Active confirms the connection, but publication is still pending.
Open Manage Lightspeed and wait for Configuration is current before linking the property.

output_examples.input: Why does my paid test order show in Test events but not in reporting?
output: The order reached Meta in test mode. Test events do not count in reporting.
Confirm the destination and consent settings before clearing the test event code to begin live delivery.

output_examples.input: Can I keep the browser pixel after enabling server-side tracking?
output: Yes. Meta deduplicates events with the same name and event ID within 48 hours.
Check that both Purchase events use the same transaction ID. Cart and checkout events may need matching IDs from your developer.

best_practices: Enter Lightspeed API credentials and the Meta token directly in the verified Product Metrics app.
Confirm the store, property, Meta destination, and consent banner before authorizing live delivery.
Verify delivery with a paid test order and share only its status, not customer or margin details.
anti_patterns: Pasting API credentials, access tokens, or customer details into chat or command arguments.
Treating every missing event as an error, including events withheld because the shopper declined consent.
Treating a test event as proof of live reporting or changing campaign bidding while checking delivery.

faq.question: Which Lightspeed stores are supported?
faq.answer: The guide covers Lightspeed eCom C-Series stores on the Europe and United States clusters.

faq.question: Why is Cloudflare required?
faq.answer: Lightspeed eCom has no app proxy. A Cloudflare Worker serves the tracking script and event collector on your storefront domain.

faq.question: What consent does Meta delivery require?
faq.answer: Product Metrics requires consent for advertising user data before sending Meta events. Custom events also require analytics consent.

faq.question: Can I keep my browser pixel?
faq.answer: Yes. Meta deduplicates matching event names and event IDs within 48 hours.

faq.question: When is a pay-on-pickup order sent?
faq.answer: It becomes eligible when Lightspeed marks it paid. Meta rejects events more than seven days old.

faq.question: Do refunds update events already sent to Meta?
faq.answer: No. Later refunds and cancellations do not revise Meta events that were already sent.
